title: Structured proposal view as a client-only read-only display model
context: The proposed-decisions window showed entries as markdown plus one raw evidence line; operators could not tell quotes from the proposed line or see each quote's source.
decision: Derive a read-only display model in the client from the raw entry block and render line, beat, pointer and quotes as plain text; unreadable pointers show as unknown source.
consequences: No server or parser change; quote convention is a proposal for leadwright S1-E; W4 must move the line/quote classifier into the mirrored grammar.
rationale: Smallest change meeting the ACs; avoids touching the drift-guarded parser mirror; architecture review (external and internal) approved.
rejected: Restyling the markdown only (cannot attribute quotes); extending the shared parser on both sides (heavier standing mirror for a display need).
